assertions.statement: XMI distinguishes the BPMN2.0::TextAnnotation from the native UML/EA Note.
XMI preserves the BPMN TextAnnotation text, identity and BPMN Association.
XMI preserves the native UML/EA Note text, identity and EA NoteLink.
EA BPMN export omits the semantic bpmn:textAnnotation while retaining references to its EAID.
EA BPMN export emits BPMNShape references for both the missing BPMN TextAnnotation and the non-BPMN native Note.
EA BPMN export emits two BPMNPlane elements that both reference Process A.
